Aipas Xpress C2 Urban Commuter E-Bike Overview
The Aipas Xpress C2 Urban Commuter E-Bike is crafted for riders who value efficiency, comfort, and reliability in their daily commute. Combining powerful performance with sleek design and modern technology, the C2 ensures every city ride is fast, smooth, and enjoyable—whether you're heading to work or exploring your neighborhood.
Key Features
1. Powerful and Efficient Motor

Gradient Capability: Effortlessly handles slopes up to 20° Enhance performance and responsiveness with the Brushless Motor Controller.

Charging Time: Fully recharges in 4–6 hours for minimal downtime For extra distance, consider upgrading to the C2 High-Quality Battery or adding a spare for extended adventures.

3. Smooth Ride with Adjustable Suspension

Tires: 26" × 2.0" thin tires for agile maneuvering through city traffic Pair with the Suspension Seatpost for a smoother ride on longer commutes.

4. Safety and Visibility

Lighting System: Integrated brake and tail lights for maximum visibility and rider safety

Protection: Maintain night-time visibility with a Lighted Cycling Helmet.

Transmission: Shimano 7-speed gears provide flexibility for all riding styles and terrains.

Frame: Foldable frame allows easy storage and transport—perfect for apartment living, RVs, or office parking

Ergonomics: Adjustable seat and handlebars ensure personalized comfort.

7. Urban Commuting Focus
Built specifically for urban riders, the C2 combines practicality with performance—making it ideal for daily commutes, errands, or relaxed weekend rides.
8. Multiple Riding Modes

Modes: Cruise Control | Assist | Sport | Pedal Assist | Pure Electric

Transmission: Shimano 7-speed drivetrain offers smooth, customizable power for any route.

Finish: Each color features a unique glossy finish to match your personal style.

10. Quick Charging & Easy Assembly

Ease of Use: User-friendly assembly ideal for beginners and experienced riders alike.

Summary
The Aipas Xpress C2 Urban Commuter E-Bike combines power, efficiency, and comfort in one sleek, foldable design. With a 1100W motor, 90Nm torque, and a 62-mile range, it’s perfect for navigating busy city streets or longer commutes. The C2’s durable frame supports up to 400 lbs, while its integrated lighting system ensures safety at all times.
Whether you’re a daily commuter or a weekend explorer, the C2 offers agility, reliability, and modern comfort in every ride. For a complete urban setup, add accessories like the Phone Mount and Bike Lock to make your journeys smarter and safer.
